Pacific is mortgaged and p1 only has $249, so buying it would hand them cash that extends their survival, but completing greens with hotels could be worth that tradeoff.

Actually, building out greens would cost around $3000 for all the houses, which is too much right now — p1's nearly broke anyway and my existing hotels should finish them off without that investment. I'll just unmortgage Water Works for the small $83 cost and end my turn there.
